title: The Courtyard Echo Contradiction
description:
Witness B: 'The gun fired from the open West field, but the sound echoed off the West open field.'
Acoustics Report: Open fields produce zero echoes; echoes require solid walls.
question: Which witness is lying?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the witness name.

Example:
Witness B
solution_explanation: Open fields have no solid surfaces to reflect sound. Witness B lied about hearing an echo off an open field.
